changelog:
v2.6.6 — DOCTOR CRASH FIX:

🎯 Fixed the Freezer Doctor crashing the app ("keeps stopping" → back to homepage).

Root cause found: the Doctor ran raw dumpsys package dumps — their 1-2MB replies blew Android's ~1MB binder IPC limit, which kills the shell process and crashes the app with it.

✅ Every shell command output is now capped at 64KB BEFORE it crosses the IPC boundary (app-wide protection).
✅ dumpsys calls trimmed server-side — tiny replies only.
✅ Doctor + freeze/unfreeze taps are fully crash-armored: if anything ever fails, the app survives and SHOWS the error instead of dying.

Also to be clear: a frozen app is NOT dead. Frozen = the OS refuses to run it. The app, its data, everything is intact and recoverable.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.5.
